data.gender_notes: Fareess is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'farasah', meaning 'to elevate, exalt'. In Islamic tradition, Fareess symbolizes spiritual enlightenment and freedom from worldly burdens. The name Fareess carries the meaning “Light, free, lofty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fareess usually hope their child will grow to embody light, free, lofty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fareess total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
